hooks.name: Schema change guard
hooks.description: Reminds to ask the user before making decisions that require two-person approval per Schema v0.1

action.prompt: Before writing or modifying any file, check: does this change introduce a new edge type, modify an existing node/edge schema, change ID rules, or alter the confidence/quality policy? If yes, STOP and ask the user for confirmation — Schema v0.1 is frozen and changes require two-person approval.
